body:
So, basically a thread to post things to alert other staff members, without creating a seperate thread, such as:
"Watch this guy, one more infraction then ban"
or
"Watch this guy, I saw him hacking on another server"
or
"I can't tell if this guy is hacking or not, here's a recording"
Don't know if player reports is an appropriate section... but here it is! :P

Review Splade4812(Auto-Clicker)[Punishment claimed by Sulorak]: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VyTgNF7HD3M (Adding more vids soon)
If you can, record splade pvping with /toggle blood show.
Review SkyBoss123(Hacking on  other servers)

Review TheWildNinja2(Hacking) Was reported by two highly-skilled players, logged off perhaps from /list
